definitions.short: Hodavjah , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H1938. Hodavyah הודיוהו הוֺדַוְיָהוּ, הוֺדַוְיָה, proper name, masculine see below ידה .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: even Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.
